messages.author: 6790150ad0fb7f2d
messages.subject: Error in head(hflights) : object 'hflights' not found
parts:
Hi

I am just getting started with dply (I currently use plyr), and I was just trying to run through the examples that are on "hadley/dplyr" as suggested and I get the following error when running:

> head(hflights)
Error in head(hflights) : object 'hflights' not found

I have installed using the following:

devtools::install_github("hadley/dplyr")

Perhaps I am missing something obvious.

Thanks,
-Steve
